# Vibration (generated by cases/vibration.py)

Forced response of each frame (frame.py's screw-pad model, feet held) to the NEMA 34's torque ripple at its full-step rate, by modal superposition (CalculiX *STEADY STATE DYNAMICS, 2 % damping in every mode). Numbers are at a 0.4 N*m ripple (3 % of the holding torque) and scale with it.
